author: feenberg
body:
From http://taxsimtest.nber.org/options.html

```

option 51 | Set to 1 for compulsory itemization for all taxpayers, set to 2 for compulsory standard deduction
for all taxpayers, set to 3 to itemize if that lowers federal taxable income, even if it raises federal plus
state liability. Otherwise the default is to minimize federal plus state liability.
-- | --
```

I am fine with making 3 the default for testing, but I am not sure that it always lowers federal tax.

New Jersey is problem when optimizing itemization. I hadn't realized Taxsim was doing that and it won't be an easy fix. I'll think about it.
